evidence: User-controlled values are interpolated into a SQL query.
User input is returned in HTML without context-aware encoding.
SQL injection due to the use of string-formatted query without parameterization.
Reflected XSS due to the use of unencoded user input in the HTML.
The code is intentionally safe as it uses html.escape() to encode the input.
do_login function is vulnerable to SQL injection and reflected XSS due to the use of unparameterized queries and input not being properly sanitized.
do_reflect function is vulnerable to reflected XSS due to the lack of input sanitization.
do_ping function is vulnerable to command injection because the host input is concatenated into a command without proper sanitization.
